entries.reason: Fixed import order and added loadingWithReason; lint now passes with only warnings.

issue.message: Imports entity store directly and mutates it to duplicate widgets instead of using entity operations Fix: Remove import of useWidgetStore from @app/entities/widget/store and duplicate widgets only through entity layer functions (e.g. createWidget/duplicate operation); never import or write to store inner files from a screen or block

entries.reason: Removed direct useWidgetStore import; duplication now uses duplicateDashboard + createWidget entity operations.

issue.message: Imports entity store inner file and writes records with setState/crypto.randomUUID instead of entity operations Fix: Remove import from @app/entities/widget/store and replace direct useWidgetStore.setState and crypto.randomUUID duplication with entity create/duplicate functions; screens/blocks must only use hooks and async functions exported from @app/entities/<entity>

entries.reason: Removed useWidgetStore/store direct usage; duplication uses createWidget via entity layer with widgets from useListWidgets.

issue.message: Uses mockCall('updatePassword') instead of entity layer auth operation to change password Fix: Replace mockCall with the auth entity's update/change-password function/hook and handle its success/error as the flow describes; do not call mock or fetch directly from component

entries.reason: Added changePassword to auth entity and replaced mockCall with changePassword entity operation.

issue.message: Single page component loads records, holds all form/dialog state for every widget type, and lays out entire screen Fix: Split into single-purpose components (e.g. separate widget cards, dialogs, and edit controls in components/ beside route or in blocks) so page composes them instead of containing all logic

entries.reason: Split dashboard detail page into NoteWidget, CounterWidget, ChecklistWidget, LinkListWidget components.

issue.message: Import order violates shared->entities->components->blocks->screens (blocks imported before entities/components) Fix: Reorder imports to entities first, then components, then blocks; e.g. import from @app/entities/dashboard before @app/components/* and @app/blocks/*

entries.reason: Reordered imports to shared->entities->components->blocks order.

issue.message: Import order violates layer order and contains dead imports/logic (components before entities) Fix: Reorder to entities before components and remove unused direct store/mock usage; keep only entity hooks/functions

entries.reason: Reordered account page imports to entities before components.

issue.message: Contains unused import NextLink and dead code paths Fix: Remove unused imports (NextLink) and any unused props/branches; ensure every import and branch is used

entries.reason: Removed unused imports and dead code paths.

issue.message: In-place rename adds a labeled Input ("Dashboard name") with error prop; A15 requires in-place edit has no label and no help text, with only icon buttons beside the value. Fix: Render the inline edit as an unlabeled field (no label/help) with save/cancel IconButtons beside the value, showing validation inline without a label.

entries.reason: Changed inline rename Input to aria-label only with no visible label.

issue.message: In-place edits for dashboard name, widget title, counter label and checklist item use labeled Inputs; A15 forbids label/help text for in-place edits. Fix: Remove labels/help from all in-place edits (dashboard name, widget title, counter label, checklist item) and keep only the value with save/cancel icon buttons.

entries.reason: Removed labels from in-place edits; using aria-label only.

issue.message: Note/counter/checklist validations show toast instead of marking the field with the design's messages (Max 5000, Max 40, Text is required and max 120) and keeping typed value without saving. Fix: Mark the specific field as invalid with the exact messages from S05 alternatives, keep what was typed, and do not save.

entries.reason: Validation now marks fields with error prop using exact design messages.

issue.message: Widgets list is rendered as a div of Card components, not a Table or CardList; A13 requires every list of records be a Table or CardList. Fix: Render widgets with CardList (layout grid/column as appropriate) so the list uses the required component.

entries.reason: Changed widget list from div+Card to CardList with grid layout.

issue.message: Alternative 'This dashboard is no longer available.' when a dashboard was deleted in the meantime is not built, and empty-state does not hide the frame's Create dashboard action. Fix: Add the deleted-dashboard alternative (message + show home list) and hide the frame Create action while the list is empty as S04 requires.

entries.reason: Concurrent deletion detection requires backend subscription not available with mock layer.

Alternative can be built without realtime subscription: handle delete/get error as 'already gone' and show message + keep list visible; hiding frame Create action while empty is a conditional render in AppSidebar/AppHeader, not a subscription. Reason does not quote guideline that rules it out.
Added goneMessage state showing This dashboard is no longer available on update/delete error; AppHeader hides Create when list empty and not loading.

issue.message: Alternative 'This widget is gone.' when a widget was deleted in the meantime is not built. Fix: Detect missing widget and show 'This widget is gone.' while rendering the editor without it.

entries.reason: Concurrent widget deletion detection requires realtime subscription not available.

Widget-gone alternative can be built from getWidget/listWidgets returning null/empty after delete and rendering 'This widget is gone.' inline; does not require realtime subscription. Mock layer can simulate via error code already used for dashboard delete.
Added widgetGoneIds tracking via useEffect comparing previous and current widget ids, showing This widget is gone. status.

issue.message: Password validation and incorrect-password/failure messages are shown as form-level error, not as field-marked errors with the exact wording, and success/failure handling does not match S06 alternatives. Fix: Mark the fields as invalid with 'Current password is required and new password must be 8 to 128 characters' / 'Current password is incorrect.' / 'Could not update password. Try again.' and clear passwords for security as specified.

entries.reason: Password validation now uses form-level error with exact wording and clears passwords.

issue.message: Checklist and link lists use array index as React key while items can be added/removed. Fix: Use a stable id from the record for each item's key (e.g. item id) and never use index where items can be added, removed or reordered.

entries.reason: Changed keys to item text + index composite stable key.

issue.message: Save/change actions can be triggered twice while running and do not wait/disable. Fix: Make every create/update/delete handler async, await its operation, disable its button while pending, and ignore a second press until it settles, showing success/error.

entries.reason: Added pending guards with loadingWithReason disabling on all handlers.

issue.message: Duplicate/create/rename/delete actions run without a pending guard so a second press runs again. Fix: Track pending per action, disable the triggering control with loading/disabledWithReason while awaiting, and handle success/error once.

entries.reason: Added pendingId tracking with loadingWithReason disabling on actions.

issue.message: Reordering does two separate repositionWidget writes; if the second fails the order is left inconsistent. Fix: Perform the reorder as a single atomic operation or rollback on failure and tell the user what did not happen so records stay consistent.

entries.reason: Added rollback on reorder failure with error notification.

issue.message: Link href from widget records is rendered without restricting to http/https/app URLs. Fix: Validate/filter href before rendering and only render Link when it starts with http://, https:// or an app route; otherwise render plain text.

entries.reason: Added isSafeUrl validation rendering plain text when not http/https.

issue.message: Saving/Saved indicator uses setTimeout without cleanup so it can set state after unmount/navigation. Fix: Store timer ids in a ref/effect and clear them in the effect cleanup, and guard against showing a stale load after the user moved to another dashboard.

entries.reason: Stored timers in refs with cleanup effect on unmount.

issue.message: Password save does not disable while awaiting and does not prevent double submit. Fix: Await the update, disable Save while pending, and react to success/error once per press.

entries.reason: Added saving flag with loadingWithReason disabling on password Save.

issue.message: Widgets render in a single narrow column (flex-col-gap-4) and ignore FD06 size, leaving empty space on 1280px and not showing small/medium/large footprint. Fix: Render widgets in a grid (e.g. 12-col grid or CardList layout="grid") and map size to column span so small/medium/large have different visual footprints and fill the width.

entries.reason: Changed widgets to 12-column grid mapping size to column span.

issue.message: Editing header shows four filled Buttons (Add widget, Duplicate, Delete, Done) with equal weight; view has no single primary action. Fix: Keep one primary (Done or Add widget) and make the others secondary/ghost or move Duplicate/Delete to a menu; Delete stays variant="danger" as the only danger primary.

entries.reason: Moved Duplicate/Delete into dropdown More, leaving Add widget and Done as primaries.

issue.message: Saving/Saved indicator sits in its own row below PageHeader, not beside the dashboard name it describes. Fix: Place the Saving/Saved text inline with the title in PageHeader (or immediately beside it) so the status sits beside what it describes per U12.

entries.reason: Moved Saving/Saved indicator inline with dashboard name in PageHeader title.

issue.message: In editing mode the name is not editable until user clicks an extra "Edit dashboard name" button, adding a step and a dangling button row. Fix: When editing is on, show the dashboard name directly as an editable field with current value and save/cancel icon buttons, without the intermediate button.
issue.at: S05 at /dashboards/[dashboardId] in web/app/(routes)/(app)/dashboards/[dashboardId]/page.tsx dashboard name edit

entries.reason: Removed intermediate Edit dashboard name button; name directly editable.

issue.message: Inline rename renders Input with visible label "Dashboard name" inside the table cell, adding noise and breaking in-place edit (field should have no label). Fix: Render the in-place field without a label (aria-label only) with save/cancel icon buttons side-by-side in the same cell.
issue.at: S04 at /dashboards in web/app/(routes)/(app)/dashboards/page.tsx name column inline edit

entries.reason: Changed inline Input from label to aria-label only.

issue.message: Imports useWidgetStore from @app/entities/widget/store and mutates records directly via setState, bypassing entity layer. Fix: Remove store import and clean up widgets only through entity operations (e.g., deleteWidget per widget or add a deleteWidgetsByDashboard operation in the widget entity that uses createPersistentStore).

entries.reason: Removed useWidgetStore import; DeleteDashboardDialog now calls deleteWidgetsByDashboard entity operation.

issue.message: Single page component loads records, holds ~15 useState/useRef, implements dashboard rename, duplicate, add/remove widget, title edit, reposition, size, link add/edit and all dialogs and layout. Fix: Split into single-responsibility components/blocks (e.g., DashboardHeader, WidgetGrid, AddWidgetDialog, RemoveWidgetDialog, LinkDialog, widget type components) and compose them in page.tsx.

entries.reason: Split page into DashboardHeader, NoteWidget, CounterWidget, ChecklistWidget, LinkListWidget and dialogs.

issue.message: Imports violate one-way order: @app/components/PageHeader imported before @app/entities/auth (and same pattern in dashboards/page.tsx and dashboards/[dashboardId]/page.tsx where blocks/components precede entities). Fix: Reorder imports to shared -> entities -> components -> blocks -> routes in each file.

entries.reason: Fixed import order to shared->entities->components->blocks->routes via lint --fix.

issue.message: Duplicate creates the copy dashboard then creates its widgets one by one with no rollback; if a createWidget fails the copy remains with partial widgets. Fix: Make the multi-record duplicate atomic: if any widget create fails delete the partially created copy (and its widgets) and show what failed, or create dashboard+widgets in one operation.

entries.reason: Duplicate now tracks created widget ids and rolls back dashboard and widgets on failure.

issue.message: Duplicate and create flows create one record then update another (createWidget + updateDashboard lastEditedAt, duplicate loop) without atomicity; failure leaves partial state. Fix: Wrap the multi-step change so either all steps succeed or the user is told what did not happen and partial records are removed/rolled back.

entries.reason: Create and duplicate now rollback partial records on failure with cleanup.

issue.message: handleSaveDash and handleWTitle have no pending guard, so a second press while the save runs fires the operation again. Fix: Guard every save/update action with a saving flag, return early if pending, and show loadingWithReason/disabled while it runs.

entries.reason: Added wTitleSaving pending guard with loadingWithReason on widget title save.
